app.name: NightLife Trivia
app.placeholder: Placeholder screen until the design is ready.

landing.body: Scan the QR code on the big screen to join tonight's game.

join.title: Join the game
join.intro: Pick a nickname. Other players see it on the leaderboard.

team.title: Pick your team
team.started: The game has started. You can still join a team.
team.name: Team name
team.none: No teams yet. Start the first one!

lobby.waiting: Waiting for the host to start
lobby.pending: The host will approve your team name soon.
lobby.rejected: The host didn't approve this name, so other teams won't see it. You can still play.
lobby.switchHint: You can switch teams until the first question.

host.title: Host controls
host.body: Run the night for event {{eventId}}. Coming in Milestone 4.

display.title: Big screen
display.body: The projector view for event {{eventId}}. Coming in Milestone 4.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Prize redemption and night planning. Coming in Milestone 6.

errors.not_found: We can't find that game. Check the code on the big screen.
errors.event_ended: This game has ended. Thanks for playing!
errors.wrong_phase: That can't be done right now.
errors.not_live: This question isn't open for answers.
errors.captain_only: Only your captain can answer for the team.
errors.already_started: The game has started, so you can't switch teams now.
errors.name_taken: Another team already has that name.
errors.name_not_allowed: Please pick a different team name.
errors.wrong_answer_type: That answer doesn't fit this question.
errors.wager_too_high: You can't bet more points than your team has.
errors.rate_limited: Slow down a little and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the game. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

leaderboard.title: Tonight's leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: Scores appear once the round starts.

rewards.title: Rewards
rewards.empty: Prizes show up here after the game. Good luck tonight!

question.captainOnly: Your captain answers for the team.
question.caption: Caption:
question.pausedBody: Answers wait until the host resumes the game.

locked.title: Answers are locked
locked.waiting: The host will reveal the answer in a moment.

result.reviewBody: Your answer was close. The host will decide, and points appear if it counts.
result.skippedBody: The host skipped this one. It doesn't count for anyone.
result.next: The next question is coming up.

wager.title: Final wager
wager.intro: Bet some or all of your points on the last question. Get it right to win them, wrong to lose them.
wager.none: Your team has no points to bet, so your wager is 0.
wager.label: Your wager
